/images/applications/blockbench/5.1.6-1s.method: Captured at 1080×720 through Chromium's debugging protocol from the installed amd64 Debian package (SHA-256 f26a50b266b9563abdf9fd18ee80e41d227e011df9d34d972248e1ee215dcd3d) during its passing fresh Ubuntu 26.04 functional test, with every Blockbench service host resolved to the loopback address.
